title: Ocean Sentinel Reproducibility Hierarchy and Operational Semantic Definitions

LEVEL_0.definition: No reliable provenance, hash integrity, or verification procedure exists. Stored artifacts or claimed results cannot be independently verified.
evidence_requirements: Absence of content-hash records or verification tools

LEVEL_A.definition: Artifact identity: exact stored artifact identifiable and hash-verifiable (cryptographic SHA-256). Guarantees bitwise integrity of stored files against accidental modification or bit-rot.
evidence_requirements: Cryptographic SHA-256 content hashes recorded in authoritative manifests
Explicit artifact lineage without ambiguous in-place modification
acceptable_claims: Artifact identity guaranteed against bit-rot or accidental corruption
LEVEL_A.verification_method: Direct filesystem SHA-256 computation against recorded manifest values

LEVEL_B.definition: Repeatable deterministic verification/audit of stored artifacts: given the same stored inputs and declared execution environment, the same audit or verification procedure can reproduce the same derived outputs and invariant assertions within defined deterministic tolerances.
evidence_requirements: Level A compliance on all input artifacts
Deterministic reconciliation of counts, partition distributions, leakage, pixel values, and class assignments
acceptable_claims: Dataset invariant verification repeatable by third parties on recorded data
prohibited_claims: End-to-end pipeline reconstruction from raw source sensors
LEVEL_B.verification_method: Automated execution of audit suites and reconciliation scripts verifying 100% of reported assertions

LEVEL_C.definition: Pipeline reconstruction: an independent operator can reconstruct the dataset-processing pipeline from recorded source inputs, code, configuration, and documented procedures, obtaining equivalent outputs.
evidence_requirements: Primary input availability and validated end-to-end transformation code
Demonstrated absence of NOT_DIRECTLY_VERIFIED generation steps
prohibited_claims: Independent primary sensor data acquisition validity
LEVEL_C.verification_method: End-to-end execution of pipeline from raw source files yielding matching dataset artifacts

LEVEL_D.definition: Source-process reconstruction/replication: the underlying source-generation procedure and primary sensor acquisition are sufficiently documented and independently repeatable from primary raw satellite inputs.
evidence_requirements: Independent external sensor acquisition calibration and physical ground validation
prohibited_claims: Omniscience over unmodeled physical environmental noise
LEVEL_D.verification_method: Independent external replication of data acquisition and annotation campaigns

current_ops01_evaluation.justification: All 147 physical sample images and masks, 27 parent scene tiepoint records, and metadata manifests are cryptographically verified (Level A). All dataset invariants (sample counts, 0 leakage, 0 OS pixels, 15-class taxonomy, 61/61 P3 guardrails, 220/220 Phase 7/8 tests) deterministically execute and reconcile 20/20 items from scratch (Level B). Level C and Level D are explicitly prohibited because DATASET_GENERATION_METHOD = NOT_DIRECTLY_VERIFIED remains active.

prohibition_enforcement.reason: The block-mean correspondence hypothesis and engineering alignment reconstruction are empirically supported pilot hypotheses; DATASET_GENERATION_METHOD = NOT_DIRECTLY_VERIFIED remains active.

current_ops01_evaluation.operational_statement: OPS-01 verification artifacts satisfy Level B deterministic verification reproducibility.
prohibited_interpretations: Must NOT be casually interpreted as 'OPS-01 dataset is fully reproducible'.
Must NOT claim Level C pipeline reconstruction reproducibility.
Must NOT claim Level D source-process reproducibility.
